Hey Product Hunt 👋, A few weeks ago I was in a work call, I couldn't remember the term "semantic search", for some reason I went blank it was honestly a bit awkward. I probably could have Googled it mid-call but that would just be awkward. I built Hintly so it never happens again. Hintly sits in your Google Meet toolbar and offers in-call hints like: - Defining terms names and acronyms - Fills in the blanks when you blank! - Fact checks claims live - Remembers and surfaces details about people mentioned in the call - Logs tasks intended for you ... all in real time. No bot joins your call, Hintly reads Meet's own live captions. It's off until you turn it on. First 60 minutes are free so feel free to try it out and let me know what you think! [...] Going blank on a term mid-call and not wanting to Google it while everyone is watching is such a relatable moment! ## Jitsi Meet: The Open-Source Solution for Security

Jitsi Meet is an open-source alternative to Google Meet that focuses on privacy and security. Completely free, it allows you to create meetings in one click without creating an account. You can even host your own servers for complete data control—ideal for those looking for a secure, customizable solution.

## GoToMeeting: The Robust Professional Solution

GoToMeeting is a top choice for companies needing a stable and high-performing platform. With features like screen sharing, call recording, and integration with productivity tools, GoToMeeting is a solid alternative to Google Meet, especially for professional or client meetings.

### Conclusion [...] ## Zoom: Flexibility and Popularity

Zoom has quickly established itself as a leader in online meetings. Its ability to host large-scale meetings, intuitive interface, and numerous customization options (virtual backgrounds, recordings, breakout rooms) make it an excellent choice for those looking for an alternative to Google Meet. Whether for personal or professional use, Zoom offers remarkable flexibility.

## Whereby: A Lightweight, No-Install Alternative

Whereby stands out for its simplicity. Unlike many other tools, it requires no installation or account creation to join a meeting. With its clean interface and the option to customize online meeting rooms, Whereby is perfect for those seeking a quick and intuitive solution.
